blocks.content: Take a moment before moving on.
You started with an empty canvas. Now you have a fully playable game with a menu, a scoring system, lives, pause, and a win condition. No libraries. No frameworks. Just the browser platform itself.

items: Start: A menu overlay with the game title and instructions
Launch: The ball sticks to the paddle until the player clicks or presses Space
Play: Keyboard and mouse control the paddle; the ball bounces off walls, the paddle, and bricks
Score: Each destroyed brick adds points to the HUD in real time
Lives: Miss the ball three times and the game ends
Win: Clear all bricks and the overlay flashes "You Win!" in green
Pause: Press P or Escape to freeze the game mid-round

blocks.content: Every single one of those features was built incrementally. Nothing was handed to you that you didn't understand first.

blocks.alt: Finished Brick Breaker running in the browser
